title: Search POD Customization Details
label: TIKTOK SHOP · API REFERENCE
subtitle: Updated 2026-10-14
html:
Path: /order/202606/pod_details/search

Method: [POST]

Function Description

Search for POD customization details for the specified order lines.

Common Parameters

For common parameters, refer to How to call TikTok Shop APIs - Common Parameters

Properties Location Type Require Sample Properties description
shop_cipher query string Y GCP_XF90igAAAABh00qsWgtvOiGFNqyubMt3 Use this property to pass shop information in requesting the API. Failure in passing the correct value when requesting the API for cross-border shops will return incorrect response.
Get by API Get Authorization Shop
content-type header string Y application/json Allowed type: application/json

Request Query Parameters

Properties Type Require Sample Properties description
app_key string Y 38abcd Every single app will have a unique key. Please use the specific key assigned to your app.
sign string Y 5361235029d141222525e303d742f9e38aea052d10896d3197ab9d6233730b8c Signature generated by gen algorithm. When you send API requests to TTS, you must sign them so that TTS can identify the senders.
timestamp int Y 1623812664 Unix timestamp GMT (UTC+00:00). This timestamp is used across all API requests. Developers can use this convert to local time.

Request Body Parameters

Properties Type Require Sample Properties description
main_order_id string Y 577449529742299260 TikTok Shop order ID.
query_order_lines []object Y The order lines for which to retrieve POD customization details.
^order_line_id string Y 577449529742430332 The unique identifier of the order line item.
^product_id string Y 1732453831920750867 The unique identifier of the product.
^sku_id string Y 1732453830297817363 The unique identifier of the sku.
^pod_order_data_id string Y 122343 The unique identifier of the POD customization data.

Request Sample

Query

https://open-api.tiktokglobalshop.com/order/202606/pod_details/search?app_key=123abc&sign=5361235029d141222525e303d742f9e38aea052d10896d3197ab9d6233730b8c&timestamp=1625484268&shop_cipher=ROW_RHkDDABBAAB8tKAVoAqsMTjsQZFLyNfY

Body

{"main_order_id":"577449529742299260","query_order_lines":[{"order_line_id":"577449529742430332","product_id":"1732453831920750867","sku_id":"1732453830297817363","pod_order_data_id":"122343"}]}

Response Parameters

Properties Type Sample Properties description
code int 0 The success or failure status code returned in API response.
message string Success The success or failure messages returned in API response. Reasons of failure will be described in the message.

data object Specific return information
^pod_details []object POD customization details for the requested order lines.
^^order_line_id string 577457287176491132 The unique identifier of the order line associated with the POD customization details.
^^pod_detail string pod_info_json The unique identifier of the order line item.
^status_code int 0 The status code for the POD customization details query.
